verdict.rationale: The IRS's published sign-in path for online account services requires identity proofing through ID.me. The IRS's own page names "selfie, video, and biometric data" as part of that flow, which makes it a biometric liveness wall rather than credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely. The same wall gates signed online forms such as Form 15620, so the axis applies and the product does the opposite of the story.
